# Integration Announcement

`saas/integration` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

Announce an integration: your logo, a plus sign and the partner's logo, then a headline, description and button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `partner` | logo |  |
| `headline` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Both logos with a plus sign, text beneath.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `logoWidth` | length | `"120px"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored, three table cells. | Fine. Alt text carries the names if images are blocked. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/integration', {
  "partner": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/240x80/png?text=Slack",
    "alt": "Slack",
    "href": "https://example.com/integrations/slack"
  },
  "headline": "We now work with Slack",
  "description": "Get task updates, comments and reminders in the channels your team already uses.",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Connect Slack",
    "href": "https://example.com/integrations/slack"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "saas/integration",
  "data": {
    "partner": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/240x80/png?text=Slack",

    }
  }
}
```
